say:1:1910221001:1.source_cn: 这就是传说中的外部海域啊……

say:2:1910221002:0.text: Grandma, Mom, and Morin always said this place was dangerous because Merfolk had gone missing here. They never let me come alone, and they refused to bring me along!
say:2:1910221002:0.source_cn: 因为有海裔在附近失踪过，阿嬷、妈妈、沫霖姐姐都说这里危...

say:3:1910221003:0.text: After hearing so many stories about this place, I'm finally here! I want to see everything I've always wondered about!
say:3:1910221003:0.source_cn: 听了那么多有关它的事情，终于能来这里了。我一定要把之前...

say:5:1910221004:1.text: The moment you enter the outer sea, Elphira darts around like a fish set loose in open water. She ducks into caves, pokes at seaweed, going from place to place.
say:5:1910221004:1.source_cn: 刚一进入外海，艾菲拉便如同归海的游鱼般，钻钻这个洞窟、...

say:6:1910221005:1.text: 随着她的身影，你谨慎地打量着四周。但与你想象的不同，令家族代表们无比忌惮的这处外部海域，与你们曾去过的围猎地并没有什么太大区别。
say:6:1910221005:1.source_cn: 随着她的身影，你谨慎地打量着四周。但与你想象的不同，令...

say:8:1910221006:0.text: What's so special about this place? Looks just like any other patch of sea to me.
say:8:1910221006:0.source_cn: 哪值得好奇了？这和其他海不是没两样吗。

say:9:1910221007:0.text: And I don't see anything useful for my repairs, either. What a letdown.
say:9:1910221007:0.source_cn: 也没啥能用来修理水行器的特别材料。这就是外海？

choice_prompt:10:1910221007.text: And I don't see anything useful for my repairs, either. What a letdown.
choice_prompt:10:1910221007.source_cn: 也没啥特别的材料。这就是外海？

say:11:1910221008:1.text: That's what Grandma says. Every now and then, a Merfolk who goes out alone disappears here.
say:11:1910221008:1.source_cn: 阿嬷是这么说的。因为，独自外出的海裔，偶尔会在外部海域失踪。

say:12:1910221010:1.text: Grandma told me that twenty years ago, the eldest brother of our generation disappeared right here.
say:12:1910221010:1.source_cn: 阿嬷说，在二十年前，我们这辈最年长的哥哥，就是在这里失踪的。

say:13:1910221011:1.text: Disappeared? Maybe some giant sea monster gobbled him up!
say:13:1910221011:1.source_cn: 失踪？难道撞上解决不了的大鱼怪了？

say:14:1910221012:1.text: That's what everyone thought at first, but Grandma and the others searched the area multiple times and never found any creature like that.
say:14:1910221012:1.source_cn: 一开始大家也是这么猜的，但阿嬷她们出来找了好几次，都没...

say:15:1910221013:1.text: Besides, if we ran into some giant sea monster, we'd fight back before letting ourselves get dragged away!
say:15:1910221013:1.source_cn: 而且，就算我们海裔真的遇到大鱼怪，在被抓走前也一定会反击的。

say:16:1910221014:1.text: But no matter how hard they searched, there wasn't a single sign of a struggle... It was as if he vanished completely.
say:16:1910221014:1.source_cn: 但阿嬷他们找了又找，这里却连一点搏斗的痕迹也没有……哥...

choice_prompt:17:1910221014.text: But no matter how hard they searched, there wasn't a single sign of a struggle... It was as if he vanished completely.
choice_prompt:17:1910221014.source_cn: 但阿嬷他们找了又找，这里却连一点搏斗的痕迹也没有……哥哥就像凭空消失了一样。

say:18:1910221015:1.text: I've wondered about that too... But no one knows what really happened.
say:18:1910221015:1.source_cn: 我也这么猜过……但谁也不知道事实到底是怎样的。

say:19:1910221016:1.text: Nothing adds up. This is so bizarre.
say:19:1910221016:1.source_cn: 这也不对，那也说不通，真够玄乎的。

say:20:1910221017:1.text: Yeah... After that, everyone stopped hunting here. They stopped trying to uncover the secrets of the outer sea, too.
say:20:1910221017:1.source_cn: 是呀……之后，大家就不再来这里围猎，也不再调查藏在外海...

say:21:1910221018:1.text: But I don't think we should just give up!
say:21:1910221018:1.source_cn: 可我认为，不应该就这样放弃！

say:22:1910221019:1.text: I've always wanted to come check it out. I want to know why our missing family members disappeared. If there weren't any sea monsters, what took them? And... could they still be out there somewhere?
say:22:1910221019:1.source_cn: 我一直想来这里看看，我想知道那些失踪的家人到底为什么会...

say:24:1910221021:1.text: Alright, alright! Enough questions! I get it. I'll help you look around while we're here.
say:24:1910221021:1.source_cn: 行行行！别再问了，咱知道了！咱待会顺便也帮你找找。

say:27:1910221024:1.text: Don't worry! I'm not going to ask anything else. I just wanted to thank you—
say:27:1910221024:1.source_cn: 放心，我不是想问问题，我是想向你们表达感谢……

say:28:1910221025:1.text: I said quiet! There's something over there!
say:28:1910221025:1.source_cn: 别说话！……不是，咱是说，那边有动静！

say:29:1910221026:1.text: 顺着图澜目光的方向，你们看到了一个被海草缠住的洞窟。
say:29:1910221026:1.source_cn: 顺着图澜目光的方向，你们看到了一个被海草缠住的洞窟。

say:30:1910221027:1.text: As the two fall silent, the surrounding sounds grow much clearer. Tolan wasn't imagining things. Something's making a faint noise inside that cave.
say:30:1910221027:1.source_cn: 安静下来后，周围的声音变得格外清晰。图澜没有听错，洞窟...

say:31:1910221028:1.text: It's a low, wavering sound, coming and going like the howling wind... or someone crying.
say:31:1910221028:1.source_cn: 断断续续、呜呜咽咽，好似风声，又好似人哭。

say:32:1910221029:1.text: But there's no wind beneath the sea.

say:33:1910221030:1.text: Do you think someone's trapped in there?

choice:17:0:1.text: Maybe they were too strong for him to fight?
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 敌人实力太过强大，失踪者无法反抗？
choice:17:0:1.male: Maybe they were too strong for him to fight?
choice:17:0:1.female: Maybe they were too strong for him to fight?

choice:17:1:2.text: Maybe they caught him by surprise?
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 敌人行踪诡谲，失踪者被偷袭击晕了？
choice:17:1:2.male: Maybe they caught him by surprise?
choice:17:1:2.female: Maybe they caught him by surprise?

choice:10:0:1.text: You said the outer sea was dangerous?
choice:10:0:1.male: You said the outer sea was dangerous?
choice:10:0:1.female: You said the outer sea was dangerous?

say:35:1910221009:1.text: Mhm. That's right. Every now and then, a Merfolk who goes out alone disappears here.
say:35:1910221009:1.source_cn: 嗯……是的。独自外出的海裔，偶尔会在外部海域失踪。

choice:10:1:2.text: I heard people have disappeared from here?
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 我在集会听说，外海发生过很多失踪事件？
choice:10:1:2.male: I heard people have disappeared from here?
choice:10:1:2.female: I heard people have disappeared from here?
